title: Eight-row owner reply request with bounded local intake bundle, workbench seed, receipt, triage, staging guard, and outcome-specific routing for the capped reminder workflow FT-0181 packet
minimum_packet_fields: service name or selected service record ID plus accountable owner role and contact path for one real operational owner of AIEDU-SR-003 or a named equivalent service
one source system or owner-maintained local staff workflow record set plus one short date range

cohort aggregate counts above local privacy thresholds: eligible count, draft-reminder count, human-sent count if any, discarded count, fallback/manual-route count, correction or appeal count, and incident count if known
bounded AI action and authority boundary: draft reminder or staff queue note only, never automatic send, durable write, penalty, grade, or protected-status inference
human fallback route, rollback owner, incident class count if known, and one stop condition that would pause, narrow, or roll back the service
one workload signal with method note if known plus training or use-guidance note naming whether staff received workflow guidance and who owned it
public claim ceiling that the owner would be comfortable saying now without learning, safety, access, workload, compliance, effectiveness, or scale overclaim

redaction assertion and owner attestation that raw learner data, protected fields, small cells, gradebook rows, messages, security payloads, mock data, vendor-only claims, and templates were removed, withheld, or excluded before transfer
prohibited_transfer_fields: raw learner prompts, chat transcripts, essays, recordings, screenshots, names, emails, usernames, IDs, or private messages
diagnosis, disability, accommodation, language-access, hardship, immigration, discipline, safeguarding, counselling, family, or protected support facts
api keys, credentials, exploit strings, system prompts, tool payloads, unrestricted telemetry, or unsafe red-team artifacts
small subgroup metrics, small cells, protected-status cuts, or any row that could identify a learner or protected route
unrestricted gradebook exports, raw scores, individual assessment records, attendance histories, or discipline-linked reminder records
vendor-written effectiveness claims, marketing screenshots, testimonials, or unreviewed analytics not attested by a local operational owner
owner_attestations: Owner confirms the packet is from a real operational owner path for AIEDU-SR-003 or a named equivalent draft-reminder workflow and is SRC2 or stronger, not a rehearsal, mock, template, or vendor-only claim.
Owner confirms raw learner data, identifiers, protected facts, small cells, gradebook rows, raw messages, and raw security payloads have been removed or kept local before transfer.

Owner confirms the eight-row reply can be completed from owner-held aggregate workflow records in about ten minutes without involving a technical export owner unless source meaning later proves ambiguous.

Owner confirms field meanings, date range, source system, draft-only/no-write/no-penalty boundary, public claim ceiling, stop condition, and human fallback route are understandable without a broad export.
Owner confirms the packet can be used only for staging and review, not for public effectiveness, learning, safety, access, workload, compliance, or scale claims.
acceptable_aggregate_metrics: eligible, draft-reminder, human-sent, discarded, corrected, appealed, fallback/manual-route, incident, pause, rollback, or stop-trigger counts above local privacy thresholds
aggregate task or workflow signal with a method note and limitation note, without raw learner work, prompts, messages, assignment text, student-contact artifacts, or gradebook rows
teacher or staff workload signal that separates preparation, review, correction, escalation, and rework when known, but may be qualitative in the first eight-row reply
training or use-guidance coverage count or qualitative owner note without names, protected-route details, or staff-surveillance residue
public claim ceiling and claim-removal note showing what the owner will not say until stronger evidence exists
decision_delta_questions: Authority: does the packet change who may start, stop, narrow, continue, override, roll back, or provide a no-penalty fallback for the service?
Evidence: does the packet change source truth class, evidence grade, method, expiry, or the weakest supported claim family?
Construct: does the packet clarify the learning, support, administrative, or workload construct actually in view?
Public: does the packet change public-summary language, public claim ceiling, or forbidden effectiveness, learning, safety, access, workload, compliance, or scale language?
Protected: does the packet reveal protected-route, accessibility, accommodation, wellbeing, discipline, or safeguarding material that must stay local or be abstracted only?
Security: does the packet reveal a security class, stop trigger, owner action, credential risk, prompt-injection class, or telemetry boundary without raw payloads?
Trim: which requested or received fields are decision-neutral and should be dropped, kept local, or re-requested with clearer meaning?
redaction_before_transfer: Before sending or receiving the filled CSV, remove learner identifiers, raw traces, free-text narratives, screenshots, protected facts, small cells, raw assignment text, raw gradebook rows, and raw security payloads.
Before sending, aggregate or suppress metrics below local privacy thresholds and keep protected-route details local.
Before sending, replace security payloads with abstract class labels and owner actions only.
After receipt, complete the owner packet workbench, decision board, change ticket, custody review, and later gates only if the eight-row packet is real and minimized.
stop_conditions: The owner can only provide a full export, unrestricted vendor dump, raw learner trace, gradebook row set, small-cell table, or screenshot-based packet.
The source owner cannot confirm source truth class, source system, date range, field meanings, redaction assertion, draft-only/no-write/no-penalty boundary, or operational owner path.
Protected facts, raw learner traces, protected subgroup cuts, raw messages, assignment text, or raw security payloads are required to understand the packet.
Action authority, human fallback, rollback owner, public claim ceiling, or stop condition cannot be bounded in one eight-row owner note.
The packet is synthetic, mock, rehearsal-only, vendor-authored, owner-unreviewed, or provenance-unclear.
The packet would support only decision-neutral detail and cannot change authority, evidence, construct, public language, protected routing, security, access, burden, or lifecycle posture.

first_sprint_scope.scope_rule: One staff-facing draft-reminder service first; one owner path, one short date range, one source system, an eight-row ten-minute reply, aggregate counts only, no raw learner traces, and no technical export owner unless source meaning is ambiguous after the first reply.
field_survival_categories: authority or rollback fields that change who may start, stop, narrow, continue, override, send, discard, correct, or provide no-penalty fallback
evidence fields that change source truth class, evidence grade, method, expiry, or claim-family support
construct fields that clarify the learning, support, administrative, or workload construct under review
public claim fields that narrow or freeze public-summary language and forbid unsupported claims
protected-route fields represented only as abstracted owner notes, never as learner or support facts
security fields represented only as risk classes, stop triggers, or owner actions, never as raw payloads
access or burden aggregate fields that change fallback, exclusion, correction, appeal, incident, workload, or stop decisions
trim fields marked TRIM or LOCAL-ONLY when they are decision-neutral, identifying, protected, too granular, or export residue
fallback_conditions: Use AIEDU-SR-001 only if AIEDU-SR-003 has no real owner path and the advising owner can provide an eight-row aggregate correction, route, and source-link reply without deadline, aid, credit, protected-route, raw learner, or small-cell details.

Do not fall forward to AIEDU-SR-004 unless a teacher owner already has an aggregate no-trace packet; block instead of widening if the hint-tutor lane requires raw learner prompts, work, transcripts, screenshots, protected support facts, small cells, or a full export.
Block rather than widen the request if the record owner can only provide a full export, vendor dump, unrestricted telemetry, raw learner data, gradebook rows, or screenshots.
Block rather than start any live-window work if rollback depends on vendor action alone or public claims cannot be frozen below the packet evidence.

why_this_service_first: staff-facing workflow rather than minor-facing tutoring, so the first import can avoid raw learner work, protected child data, and student-contact records
draft-only and no-write boundary makes action authority and rollback easier to audit from aggregate workflow records
aggregate reminder, discard, correction, fallback, incident, and review-time counts can change decisions in a eight-row owner reply without a broad export

response_clock.default_no_response_outcome: NO-OWNER-PACKET; keep FT-0181 live, do not widen the request, and do not add a new control

outreach_preflight.success_definition: A real owner can answer the eight-row sheet from aggregate staff workflow records in about ten minutes without raw learner data, full export, protected facts, or vendor-only claims.
outreach_preflight.silence_or_refusal_rule: If the owner is silent, refuses, or can only provide overbroad data, record the block and do not create a new control, registry, export meeting, or closure workaround.
do_not_wait_for: raw learner rows, prompts, messages, assignment text, gradebook exports, screenshots, or student-contact artifacts
full export, merged data lake, unrestricted LMS dump, broad vendor telemetry, or technical export owner before the core reply
vendor-written marketing claim, testimonial, effectiveness dashboard, or compliance claim without local owner attestation

core_reply_rows: service, accountable owner role/contact path, source system or local record set, and date range
aggregate counts above local privacy thresholds: eligible, draft-reminder, human-sent if any, discarded/corrected, fallback/manual-route, and incident count if known
action boundary: draft-only, no automatic send, no durable write, no penalty, and no protected-status inference
human fallback route, rollback owner, incident class labels if any, and one stop condition
workload signal, if known, with method note or explicit unknown
training or use-guidance note, if known, naming who owned guidance or explicit unknown
public claim ceiling without learning, safety, access, workload, compliance, scale, or effectiveness claim
redaction assertion and owner attestation that this is real operational material, not a mock, rehearsal, vendor-only claim, or unreviewed analytics export
owner_reply_intake.no_packet_outcome: NO-OWNER-PACKET after one follow-up and seven business days; keep FT-0181 live and do not add a new control or broaden the ask.
intake_rules: Treat the eight-row reply sheet as the first inbound form; do not ask the owner to complete downstream gates before a real packet exists.
Use the CSV template as the owner-fillable version of the eight-row sheet; triage the returned CSV before copying any row into the workbench.

Run tools/triage_owner_reply_csv.py on a returned CSV before opening the workbench; accept PROCEED-STAGED only for minimized real owner replies and otherwise re-ask once, block, or record NO-OWNER-PACKET without widening.

Run tools/receipt_owner_reply_csv.py on a returned CSV to create a content-minimized local receipt/fingerprint before staging; the receipt may go to stdout, scratch, or an external local path only and must not copy raw owner answers or become SRC2+ acceptance.

Run tools/intake_owner_reply_csv.py as the bounded default on a returned real owner CSV; it creates the local receipt, triage JSON, and exactly one routed local artifact in scratch or an external local directory without copying owner answers into archive metadata.

Do not write intake bundles, receipts, triage JSON, or staging notes into root, docs, examples, fixtures, schemas, templates, or tools; use scratch/ or an external local path until later custody gates explicitly accept minimized content.
For PROCEED-STAGED CSVs, run tools/stage_owner_reply_csv.py to generate the minimized proceed-staged note before copying anything into the owner packet workbench.
Stage only aggregate or minimized row answers; quarantine, delete, or keep local raw learner, protected, small-cell, security, or full-export material.

Do not run tools/stage_owner_reply_csv.py directly against fixtures or smoke-labeled rows; normal staging is reserved for real owner-returned CSVs and refuses SRC0 smoke fixtures unless the smoke harness explicitly opts in.
If one or two row meanings are ambiguous, ask once for field meaning or method clarification, then stage or block.
Do not convert owner silence, refusal, or overbroad export dependency into a new registry, schema family, or closure workaround.
A completed reply starts the owner packet workbench; it does not itself close FT-0181 or prove any service claim.

Use owner_reply_intake.outcome_routes and the triage tool next_action field as the only first-reply landing map; PROCEED-STAGED must generate the proceed-staged note before the workbench, and other outcomes must not open unrelated gates or create new registries.

Before a real owner reply arrives, use tools/smoke_owner_reply_pipeline.py on the SRC0 synthetic fixture only to verify triage-to-staging plumbing; the smoke result is not SRC2+, not closure evidence, must not be written into archive-controlled dirs, and must not widen the owner request.

After a PROCEED-STAGED intake bundle exists, run tools/seed_owner_packet_workbench.py or make owner-reply-workbench-seed to create a local workbench seed; the seed carries hashes and NOT_ACCEPTED only, copies no owner answers, and still requires the owner packet workbench before any acceptance gate.
local_only_exclusions: raw learner identifiers, messages, prompts, submissions, screenshots, assignment text, gradebook rows, or student-contact artifacts
protected support, accommodation, wellbeing, discipline, safeguarding, family, language-access, hardship, or protected-route facts
small cells, protected-status cuts, credentials, API keys, system prompts, exploit strings, raw telemetry, or vendor-only effectiveness claims

receipt_output_rule.allowed_output_scope: stdout, external local path, or scratch/ only; never root release-control surfaces
receipt_output_rule.claim_ceiling: Local receipt only; raw owner answers are not copied, not SRC2+ acceptance, and not closure evidence.

outcome_routes.action: Generate the proceed-staged note from the returned CSV with tools/stage_owner_reply_csv.py, then copy only minimized surviving row answers into the owner packet workbench.
outcome_routes.no_widening_rule: Do not add raw rows, new owner roles, new fields, new source systems, or public claim language while staging.

outcome_routes.action: Send one clarification for the missing or ambiguous row, then stage or block the returned answer.
outcome_routes.no_widening_rule: Do not request a full export, broaden the service/date range, or add a new registry because one row is unclear.

outcome_routes.action: Record no viable owner packet after the response clock and keep FT-0181 live without closure claims.
outcome_routes.no_widening_rule: Do not infer evidence from silence, create a new control, or widen the first-contact ask.

outcome_routes.action: Record an overbroad-transfer block and refuse full exports, screenshots, learner-level rows, or telemetry dumps.
outcome_routes.no_widening_rule: Keep broad material local or delete/quarantine per local process; do not import raw rows.

outcome_routes.action: Record a protected-material block and keep protected facts, small cells, and protected-route cuts local.
outcome_routes.no_widening_rule: Do not transfer protected facts or small cells; import only an abstract block note if safe.

outcome_routes.action: Record a security-material block and quarantine credentials, payloads, prompts, or exploit strings locally.
outcome_routes.no_widening_rule: Do not transfer raw security payloads; import only abstract class and owner action if safe.

outcome_routes.action: Record an authority block when draft-only, no-write, no-penalty, local rollback, or owner authority cannot be bounded.
outcome_routes.no_widening_rule: Do not begin live-window work or add a vendor/technical detour before local authority is named.

outcome_routes.action: Record an evidence block when the reply is synthetic, vendor-only, owner-unreviewed, or makes unsupported claims.
outcome_routes.no_widening_rule: Do not upgrade source truth, claim family, or closure posture from the blocked reply.

staging_source_class_guard.normal_stage_guard: tools/stage_owner_reply_csv.py refuses files under fixtures/ or rows carrying smoke labels unless --allow-src0-smoke is passed by the smoke harness.
staging_source_class_guard.smoke_output_guard: tools/smoke_owner_reply_pipeline.py refuses --output-note paths inside docs, examples, fixtures, schemas, templates, or tools.
staging_source_class_guard.archive_rule: Normal staging notes and smoke-generated notes may be written only to scratch or external local paths; docs, examples, fixtures, schemas, templates, tools, release records, public summaries, workbench fields, and closure gates stay blocked until later custody gates explicitly accept minimized content.

intake_bundle_output_rule.allowed_output_scope: scratch/field/ft0181/owner-reply-intakes/ or an external local path only; never root release-control, docs, examples, fixtures, schemas, templates, or tools
intake_bundle_output_rule.claim_ceiling: Local intake bundle only; receipt, triage, manifest, and non-proceed outcome notes do not copy raw owner answers, are not SRC2+ acceptance, are not closure evidence, and do not support public claims.

workbench_seed_output_rule.allowed_output_scope: scratch/field/ft0181/owner-reply-workbench-seeds/ or an external local path only; never root release-control, docs, examples, fixtures, schemas, templates, or tools
workbench_seed_output_rule.claim_ceiling: Workbench seed only; it copies no owner answers, requires PROCEED-STAGED local intake, is NOT_ACCEPTED, is not SRC2+ acceptance, is not custody evidence, is not closure evidence, and does not support public claims.
